tui_runtime_views_confirm_accept: Label next to the Enter key cap in the TUI confirmation modal (restart all). Lowercase, after the key name.
tui_runtime_views_confirm_cancel: Label next to the Esc key cap in the TUI confirmation modal (restart all). Lowercase, after the key name.
tui_runtime_views_devices_detecting: Status line of the TUI device picker while adb or xcrun still runs. The ellipsis marks a wait.
tui_runtime_views_devices_found: Status line of the TUI device picker once detection finished. {count} is the number of devices.
tui_runtime_views_devices_navigate: Footer hint of the TUI device picker, after the up and down arrows.
tui_runtime_views_devices_none: Body of the TUI device picker when detection found nothing; the hint follows.
tui_runtime_views_devices_select: Footer hint of the TUI device picker, after the Enter key.
tui_runtime_views_devices_spawn_without: Footer hint of the TUI device picker (empty list), after the Enter key.
tui_runtime_views_devices_title_android: Title of the TUI device picker for an Android session.
tui_runtime_views_devices_title_ios: Title of the TUI device picker for an iOS session.
tui_runtime_views_help_actions: Section of the TUI help listing the actions of atlas.yaml with their keys; shown in capitals.
tui_runtime_views_help_ctx_all: Suffix in parentheses after a row of the TUI help that only works on the All tab (the first tab, whose name is tui_runtime_widgets_tab_all).
tui_runtime_views_help_ctx_service: Suffix in parentheses after a row of the TUI help that only works on a service tab.
tui_runtime_views_help_ctx_session: Suffix in parentheses after a row of the TUI help that only works on a session tab.
tui_runtime_views_help_foot: Last line of the TUI help modal. {close} is the keys that close it (esc / ?).
tui_runtime_views_help_foot_scroll: Last line of the TUI help modal when it scrolls. {arrows} shows which directions have more, {scroll} is the scroll keys, {close} the keys that close it.
tui_runtime_views_help_open: Section of the TUI help listing the keys that open a service in the browser; shown in capitals.
tui_runtime_views_help_title: Title of the TUI help modal.
tui_runtime_views_help_title_range: Title of the TUI help modal when it scrolls: the rows in view of all rows.
tui_runtime_views_menu_cancel: Last line of the TUI service menu. {key} is the Esc key name.
tui_runtime_views_menu_restart: Entry of the TUI service menu, after the r key.
tui_runtime_views_menu_start: Entry of the TUI service menu for a stopped service, after the t key.
tui_runtime_views_menu_stop: Entry of the TUI service menu, after the s key.
tui_runtime_views_quit_attached_headline: First line of the quit modal in an attached TUI.
tui_runtime_views_quit_attached_hint: Second line of the quit modal in an attached TUI: the commands are part of the line.
tui_runtime_views_quit_detach: Button of the quit modal in an attached TUI: leave and keep the runner's services running.
tui_runtime_views_quit_owner_headline: First line of the quit modal in the owning TUI.
tui_runtime_views_quit_owner_hint: Second line of the quit modal in the owning TUI. {command} is `atlas dev --detach`.
tui_runtime_views_quit_quit: Button of the quit modal in the owning TUI: stop all services and exit.
tui_runtime_views_quit_stop_all: Button of the quit modal in an attached TUI: stop the runner and all its services.
tui_runtime_views_quit_title_leave: Title of the TUI quit modal in a TUI attached to a runner.
tui_runtime_views_quit_title_quit: Title of the TUI quit modal when this TUI owns the services.
tui_runtime_views_splash_starting: Line of the TUI splash screen next to a spinner while the service list is still empty.
tui_runtime_views_splash_tagline: Subtitle of the TUI splash screen: alone when atlas.yaml has no project name, and after the project name.
